title: Ayakashi Ninden Kunoichiban Plus
native_title: あやかし忍伝くの一番 プラス
overview:
A big hit on other platforms!! "Ayakashi Ninden Kunoichiban" comes to the Sega Saturn, powered up! With added ending visuals, the exploits of the seven girls are even more fun!

Ayakashi Ninden Kunoichiban Plus is a ninja school raising simulation set in a world where shinobi are openly part of society. The heroine Kaede enrolls at Hime Yuri Gakuen, a school for kunoichi, and spends a year studying and serving alongside the girls she grows close to. The top graduate wins the right to work as a freelance shinobi.

Plan Kaede's lessons in subjects that range from language and arithmetic to medicine, jujutsu, manners and the arts of stealth and espionage, and watch her abilities grow through the school year. Story scenes with the other girls unfold along the way, leading to one of many different endings.

- Fully voiced cast, with opening and ending theme songs
- Multiple endings, with new ending visuals in this version
- One player, two CD-ROMs, memory backup saves

他機種版で大好評！！
「あやかし忍伝 くの一番」がパワーアップしてセガサターンに登場！
エンディングビジュアルも追加になって7人の女の子達の活躍がさらに面白くなった！
